name: Pragyan Pattnaik

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Pragyan Pattnaik, whose books and columns use the byline Pragnya Patnaik, writes poetry and stories in English and Sambalpuri and translates into Odia. Her public writing also addresses social issues and women’s rights. Her books include the English story collection Love Is Not Lost.

‘A Traveller’s Tale’ begins with the loneliness of someone surrounded by company yet unable to find a shoulder to lean on. As the traveller questions the road already taken, the poem shifts from disappointment toward purpose: even a solitary journey may leave footsteps that help another person find a way.
